assessment.summary: Multiple independent sources, including Sanders' own Senate office, show he voted for the ACA and defended it against repeal, refuting the claim that he opposed Obamacare, though he criticized it for lacking single-payer.

evidence.finding: PolitiFact fact-check states Sanders voted for the passage of Obamacare, so Biden's 'opposed' claim misled viewers.
Sanders' own Senate press release says he supported the Affordable Care Act when it was passed in 2010.
NPR reports Sanders headlined Democratic rallies opposing GOP efforts to repeal the ACA in January 2017.
Reuters notes Sanders proposed replacing Obamacare with single-payer and Obama said his supporters helped undermine it, the strongest counterevidence but short of opposition to the law.

assertions.assertion: US Senator Bernie Sanders was opposed to Obamacare.

gaps: S7 roll-call snippet does not display Sanders' individual vote, so the refutation rests on Sanders' own office statement and independent secondary reporting rather than the primary roll-call record.
